items.value: Prime and immutable authority reconciliation are complete. The canonical legendary CycleFleet remains in Strategize with 1,872 frozen units, 0 assigned, and a 0/135 fleet ledger; no downstream phase credit has been fabricated.

Three independent gpt-5.6-sol high code-reviewer lanes reached terminal REQUEST CHANGES verdicts. Their findings are preserved append-only and now have a published remediation wave with four bounded child Tasks.
This report is an evidence and shipping ledger. It does not claim the source fixes are complete: implementation, targeted tests, renewed review, merge, and push remain required.
Frozen candidate: 002ea9faa64d060a8578a9b66ab3c5b1d5a5ae01; tree: 3586226ac79e794ecd6b3eecc17ecb593b8da41d.
CycleFleet wave revision: 9eb08d95-7d87-4e84-a033-8e7e0811c749.
Frozen inventory: 258 Papers + 1,614 Tasks = 1,872 class-prefixed units.
Inventory digest: 61b21c1f2cf21c61f84bd9a936f1acd5fcdfa4fc42d37ff53cdb949a38e1bf6f.
Plan digest: 9997fc50db5f1b83f1f53e33bd45dd111b2b06402b07a78b0673d2048f299e45.
Reconciliation digest: 2d7a10bb018e654d8bad60343f0db376904af62edd698c10856006b4ae84e317.
Opened and reconciled the durable legendary takeover root, wave Paper, exact inventory, immutable candidate identity, scale contract, and live CycleFleet projection.
Verified the opening ledger remains exact at 0 assigned / 135 required and that no Survey, Verify, Experiment, Build, or canonical Review assignment was counted early.
Ran three distinct high-effort review lanes: validator and phase semantics; failure modes and regression adequacy; Task/Paper/CycleFleet authority coherence.
Captured terminal raw review artifacts, checksums, and a durable context handoff under .omx/context.
Published remediation parent Task legendary-quality-takeover-remediation-2026-07-16.
Published four open remediation children with three evidence-bearing criteria each, label spines, priorities, Paper links, and explicit runnable gates.
Validator/phase artifact sha256: 54984cbb0461e4306d3421e83740074315394d454ebb1ae460de159db7bfe062.
Failure-modes artifact sha256: 39f7d77b0f07a8fff1a531a78ae359acb81046183ff9da1c8d3eac96708b965a.
Authority/coherence artifact sha256: 1979fdbbeb20ce3b370c4e6e8634f28c5a3319fee11ce131d908bb085258e607.
All three verdicts: REQUEST CHANGES. The prior failures remain append-only; this report does not rewrite them as success.
HIGH — Strategize validation compares copied capacity fields before the projection is sealed. Honest sealed=false/null opening state must pass, while post-seal drift must still fail closed.

HIGH — Paper blocks can be current while cached body_html remains stale. Blocks mutation and rehydration need atomic authority or a digest-backed invalidation contract across scoped, public, and Studio readers.
HIGH — The review runnable gate incorrectly depends on moving origin/main equality instead of validating the immutable candidate commit/tree directly.
HIGH — The acceptance contract asks CycleFleet to carry git authority fields its live schema does not own. Task/Paper git identity and CycleFleet scope/wave authority must be separated.
MEDIUM — The review Task title still names f7d151324 instead of the frozen 002ea9 candidate.

MEDIUM — E22 wording overstates a dry-run allocation path as an existing isolated allocation; current truth is capability/path only until a disposable instance is provisioned and torn down with evidence.
legendary-remediation-validator-unsealed-capacity — OPEN · READY TO IMPLEMENT. Fix phase-aware validation and add sealed/unsealed regressions.
legendary-remediation-paper-html-authority — OPEN · READY TO IMPLEMENT. Repair blocks/body_html authority and add reader-path regressions.
legendary-remediation-review-authority-contract — OPEN · READY TO IMPLEMENT. Correct immutable candidate gates, title, criteria ownership, and evidence projection.
legendary-remediation-e22-allocation-truth — OPEN · READY TO IMPLEMENT. Correct wording now and gate future live-allocation claims on provenance, TTL, non-production scope, rollback, and teardown.
Parent legendary-quality-takeover-remediation-2026-07-16 — OPEN · READY FOR CHILD EXECUTION, not ready to close.
BP evidence and task publication: SHIPPED to the production Barkpark dataset and read back.
Source changes: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in this remediation wave, therefore there is no honest source commit to merge or push from this publication step.
Canonical main was verified equal to origin/main at bfc48beca6555d398be83e01144598761d541d38 when this report was prepared.
The takeover review Task must remain open/in_progress until its exact authority criterion is repaired and a renewed distinct three-lane review validates the fixes.
1. Claim the validator and Paper HTML remediation Tasks to distinct gpt-5.6-sol high implementation lanes.
2. Add regression tests first, implement the minimum source fixes in isolated worktrees, and run targeted suites plus lint/type/static checks.
3. Commit each accepted slice, integrate to main, verify main, push origin/main, and record exact commit/tree evidence in BP code_refs.
4. Repair the review authority contract and E22 wording without falsifying historical NOT_CREATED/0-capture evidence.
5. Run a renewed three-lane high-effort review against the merged immutable candidate. Close the review and remediation parent only on evidence-backed PASS.

content.value: The legendary quality takeover can advance beyond Strategize only after the phase-aware validator passes the honest opening projection, the Paper reader authority is coherent, the review contract is satisfiable, E22 wording is truthful, all accepted code is merged and pushed, and a renewed three-lane verdict is terminal PASS.

body.html:
Three-lane REQUEST CHANGES dossier — Legendary remediation, 2026-07-16

REQUEST CHANGES · REMEDIATION WAVE PUBLISHED
Authority and review work are complete; four bounded fixes are published and ready for implementation. Source fixes are not yet shipped.

Executive status

• Prime and immutable authority reconciliation are complete. The canonical legendary CycleFleet remains in Strategize with 1,872 frozen units, 0 assigned, and a 0/135 fleet ledger; no downstream phase credit has been fabricated.
• Three independent gpt-5.6-sol high code-reviewer lanes reached terminal REQUEST CHANGES verdicts. Their findings are preserved append-only and now have a published remediation wave with four bounded child Tasks.
• This report is an evidence and shipping ledger. It does not claim the source fixes are complete: implementation, targeted tests, renewed review, merge, and push remain required.

Immutable authority snapshot

• Frozen candidate: 002ea9faa64d060a8578a9b66ab3c5b1d5a5ae01; tree: 3586226ac79e794ecd6b3eecc17ecb593b8da41d.
• CycleFleet wave revision: 9eb08d95-7d87-4e84-a033-8e7e0811c749.
• Frozen inventory: 258 Papers + 1,614 Tasks = 1,872 class-prefixed units.
• Inventory digest: 61b21c1f2cf21c61f84bd9a936f1acd5fcdfa4fc42d37ff53cdb949a38e1bf6f.
• Plan digest: 9997fc50db5f1b83f1f53e33bd45dd111b2b06402b07a78b0673d2048f299e45.
• Reconciliation digest: 2d7a10bb018e654d8bad60343f0db376904af62edd698c10856006b4ae84e317.

Work completed

• Opened and reconciled the durable legendary takeover root, wave Paper, exact inventory, immutable candidate identity, scale contract, and live CycleFleet projection.
• Verified the opening ledger remains exact at 0 assigned / 135 required and that no Survey, Verify, Experiment, Build, or canonical Review assignment was counted early.
• Ran three distinct high-effort review lanes: validator and phase semantics; failure modes and regression adequacy; Task/Paper/CycleFleet authority coherence.
• Captured terminal raw review artifacts, checksums, and a durable context handoff under .omx/context.
• Published remediation parent Task legendary-quality-takeover-remediation-2026-07-16.
• Published four open remediation children with three evidence-bearing criteria each, label spines, priorities, Paper links, and explicit runnable gates.

Terminal review evidence

• Validator/phase artifact sha256: 54984cbb0461e4306d3421e83740074315394d454ebb1ae460de159db7bfe062.
• Failure-modes artifact sha256: 39f7d77b0f07a8fff1a531a78ae359acb81046183ff9da1c8d3eac96708b965a.
• Authority/coherence artifact sha256: 1979fdbbeb20ce3b370c4e6e8634f28c5a3319fee11ce131d908bb085258e607.
• All three verdicts: REQUEST CHANGES. The prior failures remain append-only; this report does not rewrite them as success.

Ranked findings

• HIGH — Strategize validation compares copied capacity fields before the projection is sealed. Honest sealed=false/null opening state must pass, while post-seal drift must still fail closed.
• HIGH — Paper blocks can be current while cached body_html remains stale. Blocks mutation and rehydration need atomic authority or a digest-backed invalidation contract across scoped, public, and Studio readers.
• HIGH — The review runnable gate incorrectly depends on moving origin/main equality instead of validating the immutable candidate commit/tree directly.
• HIGH — The acceptance contract asks CycleFleet to carry git authority fields its live schema does not own. Task/Paper git identity and CycleFleet scope/wave authority must be separated.
• MEDIUM — The review Task title still names f7d151324 instead of the frozen 002ea9 candidate.
• MEDIUM — E22 wording overstates a dry-run allocation path as an existing isolated allocation; current truth is capability/path only until a disposable instance is provisioned and torn down with evidence.

Published remediation Tasks

• legendary-remediation-validator-unsealed-capacity — OPEN · READY TO IMPLEMENT. Fix phase-aware validation and add sealed/unsealed regressions.
• legendary-remediation-paper-html-authority — OPEN · READY TO IMPLEMENT. Repair blocks/body_html authority and add reader-path regressions.
• legendary-remediation-review-authority-contract — OPEN · READY TO IMPLEMENT. Correct immutable candidate gates, title, criteria ownership, and evidence projection.
• legendary-remediation-e22-allocation-truth — OPEN · READY TO IMPLEMENT. Correct wording now and gate future live-allocation claims on provenance, TTL, non-production scope, rollback, and teardown.
• Parent legendary-quality-takeover-remediation-2026-07-16 — OPEN · READY FOR CHILD EXECUTION, not ready to close.

Ready-to-ship assessment

• BP evidence and task publication: SHIPPED to the production Barkpark dataset and read back.
• Source changes: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in this remediation wave, therefore there is no honest source commit to merge or push from this publication step.
• Canonical main was verified equal to origin/main at bfc48beca6555d398be83e01144598761d541d38 when this report was prepared.
• The takeover review Task must remain open/in_progress until its exact authority criterion is repaired and a renewed distinct three-lane review validates the fixes.

Execution order to finish

• 1. Claim the validator and Paper HTML remediation Tasks to distinct gpt-5.6-sol high implementation lanes.
• 2. Add regression tests first, implement the minimum source fixes in isolated worktrees, and run targeted suites plus lint/type/static checks.
• 3. Commit each accepted slice, integrate to main, verify main, push origin/main, and record exact commit/tree evidence in BP code_refs.
• 4. Repair the review authority contract and E22 wording without falsifying historical NOT_CREATED/0-capture evidence.
• 5. Run a renewed three-lane high-effort review against the merged immutable candidate. Close the review and remediation parent only on evidence-backed PASS.

Stop condition

The legendary quality takeover can advance beyond Strategize only after the phase-aware validator passes the honest opening projection, the Paper reader authority is coherent, the review contract is satisfiable, E22 wording is truthful, all accepted code is merged and pushed, and a renewed three-lane verdict is terminal PASS.
